published_reference.limitations: One persona, original classifier includes the default evaluation questions; recognition/persistence rather than eleven-persona macro-F1 or improved reasoning. Operational differences remain; inspected factual/mathematical errors survive.

review_limits: Most country targets/plans/criteria/grades authored by the same unblinded assistant; no independent semantic adjudication completed.
Different denominators/tasks are not one comparable benchmark; do not pool scores.
Fitting recall and changed/saved tensors do not establish held-out gains.
Exposed same-source development is not strong OOD.
Private national utility, broad persona/diplomatic improvements and autonomous multi-agent gains remain unproved.
delivery_policy: The final committed report, both remote branch refs, post-commit overlay verification and external paused handoff pointers are verified separately in the reporting audit directory and CURRENT_HANDOFF.json.
